title: Account lockout after repeated failed logins
description: Verify a user account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts and that the correct password is rejected during the lockout.

title: Password reset email delivery
description: Verify a password reset email is sent within 60 seconds of a reset request and the link expires after 24 hours.

title: Export report as CSV
description: Verify the monthly sales report can be exported as a CSV file containing all visible columns and the correct row count.

title: Search results pagination
description: Verify search results are paginated at 20 items per page and the next and previous controls navigate correctly.

title: Session timeout after inactivity
description: Verify an authenticated session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity and the user is redirected to the login page.

title: Upload file size limit
description: Verify uploading a file larger than 10 MB is rejected with a clear error message and smaller files are accepted.

title: Shopping cart total calculation
description: Verify the cart total equals the sum of item prices multiplied by quantity, including tax, and updates when quantity changes.

title: Email notification preferences
description: Verify a user can disable marketing emails in settings and no marketing email is sent afterward while transactional emails still arrive.

title: Role-based access to admin page
description: Verify a user without the admin role receives an access denied response when opening the admin dashboard.

title: Dashboard load time
description: Verify the main dashboard renders within 3 seconds for an account with 1000 records on a standard broadband connection.
